messages:
micah: Small change to today's flow: swapping demo and Q&A. Demo will run at ~10:06, live Q&A opens at 10:22. Posting a sticky in #lobby in 90s. Also noticed a popping sound in rehearsal— can AV listen for RFI?

rafa-av: Listening now. Looks like one USB hub re-enumerated during rehearsal which caused a brief audio dropout. I'll hot-swap the presenter laptop to the dedicated AV hub and mute unused channels.

toni: Can we also brief the remote audience that we may pause video for a short period if audio flakiness continues? Would avoid people thinking we vanished.

micah: Good call. Put that in the sticky. We'll seed two leadership prompts at Q&A open (product milestones timeline + Dedicated capacity rollout plan) then open the thread to upvotes.

lin: I'll pin the seeded prompts and watch reaction/thumbs. If something needs extended follow-up, I'll add to the parking-lot doc.

anya: Posting sticky in #lobby: "Agenda tweak: demo now ~10:06, Q&A ~10:22. Upvote questions in the thread. We may briefly pause video for audio fixes; captions will remain when possible."

ops-bot: Stream healthcheck: ingest latency 0.38s, jitter 0.28s, packet loss 0.05% over 10m. Automated failover threshold = 5% loss OR >3s sustained gap.

rafa-av: Quick ops note: if OBS hiccups, fallback plan is: 1) restart capture driver, 2) if gap >2s persist for 25s switch to slides-only layout, 3) if OBS process dies then rehost to backup ingest. Failover command below.

rafa-av: ```
# trigger ingest failover
ssh ops@relay "curl -X POST 'https://ingest-backup.internal/api/failover?stream=all-hands'"
```

toni: For captions: vendor latency ~1.1s. If captions drop, we will continue slides and post a full transcript + timecoded highlights within 6 hours.

micah: For the Q&A facilitation: I'll call two seed questions, then Lin will surface highest-upvoted internal questions. Jen will be on stage for SLA/timeline clarifications.

lin: I'll also watch DMs and copy any high-quality remote Qs into the thread. Please avoid duplicating existing upvoted items.

rafa-av: Just swapped presenter laptop to AV hub, monitoring audio levels now at -7dB. No more USB re-enumeration in the log.

ops-bot: Deploy note: recording container image built and smoke-tested at 09:52 UTC. If program switches to recording-only, retention will still be recorded and uploaded to the shared bucket.

toni: If anyone needs last-minute slide edits, DM me with `slide:<num>` and `note:<one-line>` and I'll push immediately.

micah: After the meeting I'll assemble the Q&A log and follow-up items into #all-hands-summary and attach time-stamped clips for any sections we cut. Thanks everyone 1:00 standup energy7. See you on-stage in 8.

rafa-av: Final check: captions ON, camera presets loaded, audio stable. Switching to live layout in 45s. Good luck! :rocket:
